subject: FB-5: Scale to full split if pilot signal warrants
description: Conditional on FB-4 showing a meaningful ON-vs-OFF signal, scale from the fast split to the full FeatureBench split for a publishable n. Re-run the same 3-arm protocol and stats at full scale; record cost/runtime. Gate: only proceed if the pilot delta is directionally positive and worth the spend. Depends on FB-4.
